# Mono Studio

> Focused, private iPhone apps for daily practice. One thing, done well.

Mono Studio makes small apps that do one useful thing, take seconds to use and keep personal data on the device by default.

## Apps

- [Keel](https://monostudio.site/keel): A weight tracker that shows the trend rather than daily noise. Available on the App Store.
- [Fork](https://monostudio.site/fork): A tuner for guitar, bass and ukulele, with a chromatic mode and adjustable reference pitch. Available on the App Store.
- [Lune](https://monostudio.site/lune): Explore the Moon in 3D, with phases, rise and set times and a moon calendar. In TestFlight.
- [Enso](https://monostudio.site/enso): Draw one circle each day and watch the year fill in. In TestFlight.
- [Bins](https://monostudio.site/bins): See which bin goes out next and get a reminder before collection day. On the App Store.
- [Dalen](https://monostudio.site/dalen): One sheet of notes you can pin to your Lock Screen. Available on the App Store.
